title: AAPS stops running loop silently (no errors)
symptom: Occasionally AAPS stops running loop. Autosens also stops updating. AAPS log shows messages about adjusting bucketed data time and aborting calculation thread due to no bucketed data available.
cause: The issue seems to be related to how Eversense logs BG data, but it may impact other sensors. The log indicates that the calculation thread is aborted because no bucketed data is available.
fix: Increasing the fallback threshold slightly allows loop to continue working. The issue is completely reworked in dev version.
evidence_quote: In this case it seems to be something to do with how eversense logs BG data but it may impact other sensors. Increasing the fallback threshold slightly allows loop to continue working.
